full_judgment: 5. Mr Roushan Ali, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that the suit in the present form is not maintainable and that the appellate Court judgment is not a proper judgment of reversal inasmuch as the evidence of the PWs as well as the documentary evidence were not properly considered by the learned Judge of the lower appellate Court. He further submits that through fraud and misrepresentation the plaintiff obtained the order of allotment and when it was detected that by practicing fraud the plaintiff obtained the order of allotment in his favour the allotment of the plot in favour of the plaintiff was cancelled by the appropriate authority and as such he submits that this appellate Court judgment is not maintainable in law.
